articles.title: Senator Kennedy says he hopes Jensen Huang enjoyed his affair with Alice Huang because 'it's the most expensive sex since Helen of Troy'
articles.summary: Republican Senator John Kennedy has mocked Nvidia founder Jensen Huang over his reported affair with Alice Huang, a woman suspected of being a Chinese
articles.body: Republican Senator John Kennedy has mocked Nvidia founder Jensen Huang over his reported affair with Alice Huang, a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy, saying he hoped the billionaire had enjoyed himself because it was “the most expensive sex since Helen of Troy”. Kennedy made the remark during an appearance on NBC's Meet the Press on Sunday, November 22, when host Kristen Welker questioned whether Huang's reported relationship with Alice Huang had created a national security risk for the United States.Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was an executive at Megaspeed International, a Singapore-based company that has been under scrutiny over allegations that it helped divert advanced Nvidia artificial intelligence chips to China in violation of US export controls.Kennedy, a Louisiana Republican known for his sharp one-liners, said he was less interested in Huang's personal conduct than in understanding how China had apparently managed to circumvent American restrictions on advanced chip exports.“Mr Huang ... did what he did. I hope he had a good time. It was the most expensive sex since Helen of Troy,” Kennedy said. The reference was to Helen of Troy, the legendary figure in Greek mythology whose abduction sparked the Trojan War.Questions over China's access to Nvidia chipsThe senator turned his attention to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, demanding answers about how restricted Nvidia technology allegedly reached China. Kennedy said he wanted both officials to appear under oath before a Senate committee and answer questions about the alleged circumvention of export controls. He suggested that officials at the Commerce Department were either so incompetent that they should not be put in charge of a food truck or had knowingly allowed the alleged violations to happen.The controversy has put the spotlight on Megaspeed, which is suspected of facilitating billions of dollars in chip transactions. The company allegedly helped move Nvidia chips through channels that bypassed US restrictions on exports to China.Alice Huang's reported relationship with Jensen Huang has also raised questions about whether Chinese intelligence could have gained access to sensitive information through the relationship.Nvidia's board has launched an independent investigation into the matter, saying it had no reason to believe that national security or company secrets had been compromised but would examine all available information. The senator said he wanted answers from the administration about how the alleged activity was allowed to happen and whether officials had failed to enforce export controls designed to prevent sensitive American technology from reaching China.You use AI every day. articles.title: California surfer somehow escapes unscathed after massive great white shark shreds his board
articles.summary: Jack Canigiula says a great white shark launched him into the air off northern Santa Barbara County, and photos show his shredded surfboard.
articles.body: A California surfer is lucky to be alive after a massive great white shark attacked his surfboard, launching him into the air and leaving the board badly mangled. Jack Canigiula was surfing off the coast of northern Santa Barbara County when the shark, which he estimated to be between 15 and 20 feet long, came charging up from below. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE FROM OUTKICK OUTDOORS Somehow, he escaped without a scratch. And the photos of his surfboard show just how close this came to ending very differently. "Welp, pretty rattled," Canigiula wrote on Instagram. According to Canigiula, he was sitting on his board beyond the breaking waves when a massive dark shape suddenly appeared beneath him. Before he could react, the shark struck the back half of his board, sending him flying. Fortunately, he managed to pull his legs forward and out of the way of the shark's mouth. But the nightmare wasn't over yet. With the shark still gripping his surfboard in its jaws, Canigiula managed to kick the animal and push himself away. articles.title: Kim Jong Un receives credentials from India's newly appointed envoy to North Korea
articles.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un on Sunday received the credentials of India's newly appointed ambassador to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea
articles.body: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un on Sunday received the credentials of India's newly appointed ambassador to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), Sanjeev Jain, along with those of nine other foreign envoys in Pyongyang.According to the state-run Korean Central News Agency (KCNA), the ceremony was held at the headquarters of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, where Kim posed for photographs with each of the newly appointed ambassadors.According to KCNA, the North Korean leader conveyed his best wishes to the leaders and people of the respective countries through the envoys. He also assured them that their diplomatic privileges and immunities would be fully protected in accordance with international law and North Korean laws and regulations.The North Korean leader expressed hope that the new ambassadors would work towards building mutual trust and strengthening friendly relations between their respective countries and Pyongyang in line with shared interests.During his address, Kim also referred to the formation of a new North Korean government following the First Session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly in March.He said the country had adopted a new political programme aimed at ensuring stable, sustained and balanced economic growth at home while expanding foreign relations based on the principles of independence, peace and friendship. He also reiterated the country's focus on protecting its sovereignty and security.Who is India's new ambassador to North Korea?The ministry of external affairs (MEA) announced the appointment of Sanjeev Jain as India's next ambassador to North Korea in July.A 2008-batch Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer, Jain previously served as India's ambassador to the Republic of Cabo Verde. He succeeds Aliawati Longkumer, who was appointed India's ambassador to North Korea on June 16, 2025.India-North Korea relationsAccording to the MEA, India and North Korea have traditionally shared friendly relations marked by cooperation and mutual understanding.Consular relations between the two countries were established in March 1962. India set up its Consulate General in North Korea in 1968, while diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level were established on December 10, 1973.The two countries also hold regular discussions on bilateral matters through Foreign Office Consultations (FOC), a mechanism for exchanging views on issues of mutual interest and concern.However, India has consistently called on North Korea to refrain from conducting nuclear and ballistic missile tests, which it has said could aggravate tensions on the Korean Peninsula.New Delhi has maintained that dialogue and diplomacy are essential to achieving peace and stability in the region.You use AI every day. articles.title: Girl sexually harassed aboard train, 22-year-old held
articles.summary: Railway police arrested a 22-year-old for allegedly sexually harassing a 16-year-old girl on Rajyarani Express near Thiruvananthapuram North station.
articles.body: Thiruvananthapuram: Railway police arrested a 22-year-old man for allegedly sexually harassing a 16-year-old girl aboard Rajyarani Express near Thiruvananthapuram North railway station in the early hours of Monday.The accused, identified as Aravind, a native of Edava near Varkala, allegedly misbehaved with the girl as she stepped out of the train’s washroom. The girl was travelling to Thiruvananthapuram with her family in connection with her elder sister’s admission to an educational institution.According to police sources, the girl raised an alarm following the incident, prompting her family members and fellow passengers to rush to her assistance. They caught hold of the accused and handed him over to Railway Police when the train reached the station.Police said Aravind had been working at a hotel in Wayanad and was travelling to Thiruvananthapuram after being transferred to a workplace in the capital. He is being questioned by Railway Police. The accused was produced in the court, which remanded him in judicial custody.The incident comes close on the heels of another sexual assault case reported at Pettah railway station. On Nov 10, a woman working at a private hospital in the capital was allegedly assaulted aboard Malabar Express around 8am.According to her complaint, the accused, identified as K M Vijesh (39), a native of Cheenavila in Vadasserikonam, Varkala, allegedly assaulted her during the journey.
